# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.1.1

- Logo: replaced with Google's current Google Slides product icon (`slides_2026`), with the same padding as the other Google plugin logos and a transparent background.

## 1.1.0

- Refreshed the `google-slides` skill for the latest tool surface.

## 1.0.0 - initial release

- Logo: official Google Slides product icon on a padded white tile.
- Added the `google-slides` MCP server pointing at `https://api.cursor.com/rest-mcp/google-slides/mcp`.
- Bundled the `google-slides` skill covering deck layout, styling, and per-slide PNG verification.
